items.label: Supportive Memory Foam
items.value: This back support for office chairs features high-density memory foam that contours to your body, ensuring the back support pillow is soft yet firm. It maintains its shape and offers comfort after long hours of sitting in a chair

items.label: Ergonomic Design
items.value: The DailyCuddles lumbar support pillow for car hugs your waistline and aligns your spine to its "S" shape. The lumbar support for car helps comfort your upper, middle, and lower back during prolonged sitting, bringing all-day pleasure

items.label: Breathable Mesh Cover
items.value: The soft, skin-friendly mesh cover of the office chair back support cushion allows for excellent ventilation to keep you fresh. The smooth zippers make removal easy without hassles. Just machine wash the cover for effortless maintenance

items.label: Universal for Most Chairs
items.value: Our back support for car comes with 2 adjustable elastic straps that fit securely on office chairs, gaming chairs, car seats, recliners, and more. The compact lower back pillow saves chair space for a better sitting experience

items.label: Use Anywhere
items.value: The car seat back support is lightweight and portable, meeting your various needs. Use the car lumbar pillow for support for driving seats, back wheelchairs, on airplane seats, or while relaxing on the couch. You'll always have the right support
